title: Display a map
description: The smallest complete OnlyMapJS page: one map element, one layer, and inline data. Set the camera with center, zoom, pitch and bearing.

title: Choose a basemap
description: Switch between free MapLibre basemap presets while the map runs. Layers and the camera survive the change.

title: Build with an AI agent
description: Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any agent: use Copy for Your Agent on any example, then chat to build your own customized map.

title: Add scatterplot points
description: ScatterplotLayer points from a JSON file, sized by population with a sqrt scale and coloured by category.

title: Create a choropleth
description: Shade real country boundaries by GDP per capita with GeoJsonLayer. A threshold scale labels the legend classes.

title: Draw arcs and paths
description: The same five journeys twice: PathLayer follows the real driving route, ArcLayer curves straight between endpoints.

title: Animate trips
description: Move 48 vehicles at once with TripsLayer. Each carries its own departure time, so traffic builds and thins on its own.

title: Create a heatmap
description: HeatmapLayer turns thousands of points into a density surface, weighted so large events outweigh clusters of small ones.

title: Bin points into hexagons
description: HexagonLayer bins points into counts you can pick, with the tally encoded as both colour and height.

title: Add icons and labels
description: Mark places with IconLayer sprites cut from one atlas, then name them with TextLayer. A filter keeps only the biggest cities labelled.

title: Label many features
description: PopupLayer draws a WebGL badge on every earthquake above magnitude 5, over a heat ramp of all 1,960 on a dark map.

title: Aggregate by H3 cells
description: H3HexagonLayer draws pre-binned data from a column of H3 cell ids: 45 years of cyclone tracks. H3ClusterLayer merges cells into outlines.

title: Draw spatial index cells
description: S2Layer, GeohashLayer, QuadkeyLayer and A5Layer draw spatial index cells from a column of ids. The same power stations, binned four ways.

title: Draw 3D columns
description: Stand a ColumnLayer bar on every power station, sized by capacity and coloured by fuel. GridCellLayer is the square-cell sibling.

title: Overlay an image
description: Pin one georeferenced picture to the map with BitmapLayer: an image and a bounds box, no data rows at all.

title: Add a raster tile layer
description: TileLayer takes a {z}/{x}/{y} URL template and draws NASA satellite imagery as a layer you can toggle, fade and stack.

title: Add vector tiles
description: MVTLayer turns vector tiles into real geometry styled by your own accessors: OpenStreetMap over Venice, with no basemap at all.

title: Display a GeoTIFF
description: COGLayer streams a Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF by HTTP range request. Recolour and restretch Grand Canyon elevation as GPU uniforms.

title: Place a drone photo
description: ImageOverlay reads GPS, altitude and gimbal angles out of a drone JPEG's EXIF and XMP, then draws the photo at its own ground footprint.

title: Slice a Zarr cube
description: ZarrLayer draws one 2D slice of a chunked N-dimensional array. Change select to step a forecast axis without reopening the store.

title: Place a 3D model
description: Place a glTF or GLB model at map coordinates with ScenegraphLayer. One asset, one instance per row, no three.js.

title: Load a CityJSON model
description: Load 3D buildings from a CityJSON city model: real LoD 2.2 roof surfaces with SolidPolygonLayer and full3d, or extruded footprints.

title: Inspect a BIM model
description: The BIMLayer load .ifc models in the browser with the ifc-loader widget. Pick any element, isolate or ghost the rest, and clash-test two federated models.

title: Render a point cloud
description: PointCloudLayer draws rows that carry a z: 24,336 elevation samples over the Matterhorn, sized in pixels and coloured by height.

title: Light the scene
description: Light extruded buildings with lighting presets, per-value lighting-* overrides, and a sun placed from a date with lighting-sun-date.

title: Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles
description: Render Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles through Tile3DLayer. Needs a browser-restricted Map Tiles API key.

title: Add terrain
description: Raise real terrain from a keyless DEM. Geographic layers drape onto the surface automatically.

title: Build a map story
description: Turn a map into a guided tour. Steps fire actions on a timeline, with play, pause and scrub.

title: Google 3D Tiles flyby story
description: Fly a camera across photorealistic 3D Tiles as a scripted story, with a player and a scrubber.

title: Shift basemaps on a timeline
description: Swap MapTiler basemap styles from a story timeline while the map runs. Layers and the camera hold steady as the ground changes underneath.

title: Load a file
description: Read GeoJSON, CSV, Shapefile, KML and GPX through one data attribute. The file extension picks the parser; nothing above it changes.

title: Extend the data layer
description: Teach the map a format it does not ship with registerFormat, and decode a live socket feed with registerSource.

title: Load columnar data
description: Load an Apache Arrow file with a GeoArrow geometry column, plus CSV, Shapefile and KML on one map. Columns feed the layer with no row objects.

title: Colour and size by data
description: Colour 243 cities four ways with scale(): sequential, threshold and diverging ramps, a categorical ternary chain, and sqrt sizing.

title: Write accessor scripts
description: Group accessors in a script type="om/accessors" block, then opt into full JavaScript with js for lookup tables and string work.

title: Filter on the GPU
description: Cut 21,337 points live with filter-field and filter-range. The DataFilterExtension drops rows in the shader, so ctx.stats always agrees.

title: Emit and register actions
description: Fire one custom action from a behavior, a data-emit button and ctx.emit. registerAction defines the name and the payload once.

title: Undo and redo
description: Step layer toggles, filters, basemaps and sketches back with the undo-redo widget or Cmd/Ctrl-Z. Camera moves are not undo steps.

title: Routing & Tracking
description: Draw a styled route from a LineString with the Route layer, and glide a bearing-rotated Tracking marker between position fixes. Both expand into plain deck.gl layers.

title: Compute a Route
description: Click two points and a registered RoutingProvider computes the street-following drive from OSRM. The click handler only writes origin and destination attributes.

title: Time series
description: Step a month of USGS earthquakes through time with a custom slider widget that drives a GPU filter.

title: Wire up behaviors and overlays
description: Click a neighborhood for a popup, hover a bike rack for a tooltip, and filter points with a slider — all declarative.

title: Add widgets
description: Add a legend, zoom controls, a scale bar and a live Vega-Lite chart without writing any script.

title: Use the responsive widget manager
description: Place widgets in eight logical slots that stack, cluster, and fold into drawers on narrow screens.

title: Measure distance and area
description: Measure geodesic distance and area on the map with the measure widget. Haversine lengths, spherical-excess areas, unit toggle.

title: Draw manually
description: Draw points, lines and polygons on the map, then save them as GeoJSON. Sketches join undo and redo.

title: Cut/fill volume + elevation profile
description: Measure cut and fill volume against real terrain. Per-cell DEM integration with a published error bound, six base surfaces, and a live elevation profile.

title: 3D snapping & cutting tools
description: Cut a clip box through a BIM model, export the 3D content inside a drawn footprint as GLB, and snap sketch vertices to real wall corners.

title: Live European airspace
description: Track real aircraft over Europe from a live ADS-B websocket. IconLayer with key upserts, flush coalescing and transition tweening.

title: Bay Area shipping
description: Simulated AIS vessels crossing San Francisco Bay over a websocket. Upsert by key, coalesce bursts with flush, reconnect automatically.

title: Delivery Riders
description: Three delivery riders glide along real OSRM street routes at once — one Tracking layer per rider, each interpolating independently, with matching Route layers and live progress bars.

title: San Francisco last mile
description: Fleet tracking with polled telematics: vehicle positions refreshed from a REST snapshot, with configureData attaching the bearer token.

title: Singapore rail network, 1987–2026
description: A year slider moves a filter-field window across GeoJsonLayer track and stations, so 39 years of rail network build themselves.

title: Tornado Alley, 1950–2024
description: One filter-range on a ScatterplotLayer drives the map, a ctx.stats casualty panel, a Vega-Lite histogram and undo. 13,182 storms.

title: QGIS2WebMap Plugin
description: Export QGIS maps to interactive OnlyMapJS web maps with the QGIS2WebMap plugin, then publish the result anywhere.
